title: Abstract task output row
description: One abstract's key facts: what the study is, and its one or two main findings (none when the abstract reports no results). Each fact is in the model's own words, one claim; length is reported, not limited (cost per abstract already counts verbosity). The quote is optional evidence, verbatim from the abstract, and not scored.

fact.description: one claim, in the model's own words; length reported, not limited

quote.description: optional: verbatim from the abstract, supporting the fact; not scored

about.description: what kind of study, on what system, to what end

findings.description: the main results, most important first; empty only when the abstract reports none
